security_justification.audit_integrity: Copies are compared by body hash at the exchange and the ingress, and the accounting identity makes silent loss a checked failure.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Each run needs an exact-head S1 approval; no product authentication or authorization logic changes.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Every result carries kit identity, approval reference and approving-comment hash; the kit commit must equal the approved head.
security_justification.concurrency: Restarts and outages are sequenced by retry callbacks and injected timers, never wall-clock races.
security_justification.confidentiality: Only synthetic opaque identifiers and documentation-range addresses are used; per-run keys stay in memory.
security_justification.cryptography: Session fingerprints use per-run in-memory HMAC keys; no product cryptography changes.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The collector's bounded diagnostic triples are recorded as returned; no secret or real data exists to disclose.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external system is reached: probe traffic is loopback only, enforced by the guard and an S2 stop.
security_justification.fail_posture: Any S2 stop condition halts the run; a mismatch is reported, never fixed by editing expectations.
security_justification.lifecycle: Each run is one execution guarded by a once-marker; an invalidation needs a new head, S1 and run number.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only this change directory and documentation change; no contract, package or canonical spec path is touched.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Failed authentication carries an anonymous actor and no target, per the fraud-evidence profile; no real-user data is processed.
security_justification.resource_retention: Kit, collector storage, synthetic database and logs must be deleted after confirmed role closure, including after a stop. Unconfirmed closure is a cleanup failure: retain scratch for owner-directed recovery, record its path and failed deletion state, and grant no retention exception.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Delivery retry and redelivery are the measured behaviour, inside the kit's primitives; the harness adds no delivery product.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The harness consumes the kit as an evaluator would and adds no seam into Bloodtrail.
